sources.title: Open a Joint Bank Account | Simplify Shared Costs with Monzo
Monzo Help - How to open a Monzo Joint Account

brands.evidence: Yes. You can apply for a Monzo joint current account if you're both 18 or over

client_claims.text: You can apply for a Monzo joint current account if you're both 18 or over, live in the UK full-time, and each have your own Monzo personal current account.
There's no monthly fee for the standard account.
client_claims.note: Facts cover paid plans and free plan, but not joint account fees specifically.

client_claims.text: You don't need to be a couple – you can open one with a friend or flatmate.
One of you goes to Home → + → Apply for a joint account in the Monzo app and invites the other.
The joint account has its own account number, and you each get a debit card for it.
You can both see the joint transactions, but neither can see the other's personal balance or spending.
Either of you can spend or withdraw the money in the joint account, even if one paid in more.
Opening it links your credit files; scores stay separate but lenders may consider the other person's credit history.
If you use a joint overdraft, Monzo can ask either of you to repay the full balance, not just half.
